dependency_inventory.description: Wasserstein baseline test vector from the metric operator baseline test vector pack; currently VALID_METADATA_VECTOR and NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
Discrete optimal transport solver library (e.g. scipy.optimize.linprog or POT); version must be pinned for determinism; not yet selected.
Distribution pair data layout: weights array and support array per distribution; layout must be frozen before fixture creation.
Geometric surface descriptor abstraction layer: mapping from AAL-Viz renderer outputs (SVG/Canvas/WebGL) to Wasserstein input distributions; not yet defined.
Memory layout for cost matrix storage; must be contiguous float64 array for OT solver compatibility.
GPU-accelerated OT (e.g. cuOT or JAX-based) is a future candidate; not required for planning stage.

determinism_requirements: 1D Wasserstein is fully deterministic via sort-based algorithms with no tolerance parameters.
All Wasserstein computations must be deterministic given identical inputs and frozen algorithm parameters.
For 2D and higher inputs, the OT solver must be pinned to a fixed version and configuration; solver non-determinism must be characterised before fixture creation.
Hash stability requires byte-identical output for identical inputs; floating-point non-determinism across CPU architectures must be assessed at the test vector schema plan stage.
Sinkhorn epsilon and max_iterations parameters must be frozen if approximation is used; epsilon variation must be documented as a numerical stability risk.

implementation_prerequisites.description: MetricOperatorImplementationSelectionPlan.v1 must be present and sealed with WASSERSTEIN at rank 1, readiness_status READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.
MetricComputationPreflight.v1 must be present with metric_computation_authorized: true and emits_metric_values: false.
MetricOperatorRegistry.v1 must be present with WASSERSTEIN registered as ADVISORY_ONLY and NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
MetricOperatorBaselineTestVectorPack.v1 must be present with at least one VALID_METADATA_VECTOR for WASSERSTEIN.
Ground metric (cost function) for Wasserstein on AAL-Viz geometric surface descriptors must be specified before fixture creation; deferred to test vector schema plan.
Wasserstein input shape (distribution pair type and dimensionality) must be confirmed from geometric surface descriptor analysis; deferred to test vector schema plan.

implementation_risks.description: Geometric surface descriptor dimensionality is unspecified; higher-dimensional inputs require OT or approximation algorithms with non-trivial determinism constraints.
implementation_risks.mitigation: Defer dimensionality decision to test vector schema plan; begin with 1D reference implementation only.

implementation_risks.description: OT solver non-determinism across CPU architectures or library versions could break hash stability and fixture reproducibility.
implementation_risks.mitigation: Pin solver library version; characterise non-determinism before fixture creation; require deterministic replay test in fixture plan.

implementation_risks.description: Sinkhorn regularisation introduces tolerance-dependent numerical error; epsilon variation breaks byte-identical reproducibility.
implementation_risks.mitigation: Freeze epsilon and max_iterations parameters; use log-domain stabilisation; prefer exact OT for 1D case to avoid approximation entirely.

implementation_risks.description: Degenerate inputs (empty distributions, zero-weight entries, single-point distributions) may produce undefined or infinite distances.
implementation_risks.mitigation: Define explicit NOT_COMPUTABLE guard paths in the fixture plan; add degenerate-input test vectors.

implementation_risks.description: Future implementation could diverge from planning constraints if advisory locks are not enforced fail-closed.
implementation_risks.mitigation: Keep all advisory lock checks fail-closed in schema and module; validate governance flags and authority locks on every build.

input_shape_requirements: Distributions must be represented as finite discrete measures with non-negative weights summing to 1, or as unnormalised histograms with normalisation applied before computation.

Geometric surface descriptor type (SVG path data, Canvas pixel array, WebGL vertex buffer) is not yet mapped to a Wasserstein input shape; input shape determination is deferred to the test vector schema plan.
Input pair: two discrete probability distributions or finite point clouds over a shared metric space; exact domain to be determined at test vector schema plan stage.
Input shape specification is advisory and planning-only; no computation is performed in this dossier.
Point cloud inputs require a ground metric (cost matrix or implicit metric function) to be frozen before fixture creation.
mathematical_requirements: 1D Wasserstein (Earth Mover Distance on R): computed via sorted CDF difference; deterministic and O(n log n); no approximation required.
2D Wasserstein on R^2: requires discrete optimal transport (OT) linear program; deterministic for a fixed solver and pinned configuration.

Ground metric (cost function c(x, y)) must be fully specified before fixture creation; Euclidean distance is the default candidate and has not yet been confirmed for the AAL-Viz geometric surface context.
Higher-dimensional inputs require OT or Sinkhorn approximation; any approximation algorithm must freeze tolerance parameters before fixture creation to guarantee reproducibility.
No Wasserstein computation is performed in this dossier; mathematical requirements are planning metadata only.
numerical_constraints: Float64 precision required for any future implementation; float32 is excluded.
Hash and serialization determinism required across all dossier fields.
No floating-point Wasserstein kernel execution in this planning lane.
OT solver version must be pinned before fixture creation.
numerical_stability_requirements: 1D Wasserstein on R: stable for well-separated distributions; degenerate inputs (all mass at one point) must be handled without division by zero and produce a documented NOT_COMPUTABLE path.
Discrete OT for 2D and higher inputs: condition number of the cost matrix affects solver stability; ill-conditioned matrices must be flagged in the test vector schema plan.
Empty or zero-weight distribution inputs must be handled gracefully with a documented NOT_COMPUTABLE output path.
Float64 (double) precision required throughout; float32 must be flagged as a numerical risk in the test vector schema plan.
Sinkhorn regularisation: log-domain stabilisation required for small epsilon; naive exponentiation overflows for distributions with large support.

validation_requirements.description: Baseline test vectors from the metric operator baseline test vector pack must be extended with Wasserstein-specific reference inputs and pinned expected output scalars before implementation begins.
Dossier generation must replay deterministically with stable canonical hash equivalence across all runs.
Degenerate and near-degenerate input cases must be explicitly covered in the fixture plan; NOT_COMPUTABLE paths must be documented.
Float64 precision requirement must be verified across target CPU architectures before implementation begins; float32 is explicitly excluded.
Empty distribution, single-point distribution, and equal-distribution inputs must produce documented expected outputs in the test vector schema plan.
